### 🛠️ Summary of Changes

1. **Re-engineered Integration Tests**  
   Rewrote [test/modules/kudos/kudos.spec.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/test/modules/kudos/kudos.spec.ts):
   * Initialized NestJS app using standard `@nestjs/testing` module compiler.
   * Bound the server to a random available port using `await app.listen(0)`.
   * Obtained the dynamic URL via `server.address()` and used it with global `fetch()` for executing requests across all tests.
   * Restored all critical AC contracts correctly (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, FR-3, AC-4, AC-5, and AC-7).
   * Cleaned database table in `beforeEach` and closed/disconnected resources properly during `afterAll`.

2. **Resolving dependency injection in Vitest/Esbuild environments**  
   * Adjusted [src/modules/kudos/kudos.controller.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/src/modules/kudos/kudos.controller.ts) to explicitly annotate constructor parameters with `@Inject(KudosService)`.
   * Adjusted [src/modules/kudos/kudos.service.ts](file:///harness/runs/kudos-wall/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-26T06-10-19/workdir/src/modules/kudos/kudos.service.ts) to explicitly annotate constructor parameters with `@Inject(PrismaService)`.
   * *This ensures that NestJS resolves and injects these dependencies cleanly even when compiling/testing inside Vitest, which lacks default support for generating standard `emitDecoratorMetadata`.*
